title: Zesty Filipino Eggs Bake
description: A citrusy, creamy brunch dish infused with lime leaves and baked in a wood-fired oven for a smoky finish.
instructions: Preheat your wood-fired oven to 425°F (220°C) and lightly spray a baking dish with olive oil.
In a bowl, whisk 6 eggs, 1/2 cup low-fat milk, salt, and pepper until well combined.
Stir in diced onion, bell pepper, garlic, tomatoes, lime leaves, and shredded cheese.
Pour the mixture into the prepared baking dish, smoothing the top with a spatula.
Place the dish in the preheated oven and bake for 12 minutes until the edges set and the top is lightly golden.
Reduce oven temperature to 400°F (200°C) and bake for an additional 8 minutes until the center is fully cooked.
Remove the bake from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Garnish with extra lime leaves and a drizzle of olive oil spray if desired.
Serve warm as a hearty, low-calorie brunch option.
